clean_story:
Now I will teach you What. It is the thing that makes you ask when you see new rock, new fire, or new beast. It is the pull in your chest when you do not know. It is the hand that points to sun, moon, or strange sound. It is the first step before you name, touch, or use. It is the empty space in your mind waiting for answer. This is What.

Discover now Why, How, and World.
